Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a), which shows a massive right-sided opacity causing leftward mediastinal shift, with the post-operative image (Figure 1c), the mass has been removed and the right lung has re-expanded (though not completely, as evidenced by residual basal opacity and volume loss). The heart and trachea remain shifted to the left or have not fully returned to the midline due to the chronic nature of the compression and incomplete re-expansion.
